newsitem.title: USA: Computer Network names financial officer.
newsitem.headline: Computer Network names financial officer.

text.p: Computer Network Technology Corp said Wednesday it named Gregory Barnum as vice president of finance and chief financial officer, effective July 7.
He succeeds John Brintnall, who as previously reported, left the company in December 1996 to take a similar position with Integ Inc.

Barnum, who has 20 years of professional experience in accounting, financial and business management areas, was senior vice president of finance and administration, chief financial officer and corporate secretary at Tricord Systems, Inc .
On Tuesday, Tricord announced Barnum's resignation, effective July 4.

"As the company focuses on renewed growth and profitability, Greg's extensive experience in operations planning, financial reporting and investor relations will play a key role in positioning CNT for a stronger future," Thomas Hudson, president, said in a statement.
Computer Network provides high-performance computer networking solutions.
